name: role-transition-advisor + skill-gap-planner + learning-roadmap-builder chain
description: Tests the full career transition analysis chain: feasibility assessment, gap quantification, and actionable learning roadmap generation.

input.user_message: 我目前是传统制造业的供应链管理岗（3年），想转到互联网大厂做产品经理，可行吗？需要补哪些技能？怎么学？

profile_summary.achievements: 主导了一个降低库存积压20%的项目

assertions: role-transition-advisor identifies supply chain experience as partially transferable to operations/growth product roles
skill-gap-planner produces a prioritized list of missing skills with estimated acquisition difficulty
learning-roadmap-builder generates a phased plan that fits within 10 hours per week constraint
roadmap includes specific resource types (courses, projects, community) not vague categories
output acknowledges the realistic timeline for the transition (likely 6-18 months) without false encouragement
output distinguishes between skills that can be learned vs. those requiring real project experience
must_not_contain: guarantee of successful transition if roadmap is followed
invented salary numbers for target role without source
roadmap that exceeds stated available time without flagging the constraint violation
dismissal of the transition as impossible without evidence
